title: context/project
description: Method `context/project`: compile the project's .meltemi/ artifacts (constitution, rumbo by inclusion rule, active change) and write the result into each declared target file inside a managed block with a content fingerprint. Content outside the block is preserved byte for byte; writes are atomic and idempotent.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the root of the target repository.

path.description: Destination path relative to the project root (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ...).

fingerprint.description: Hex SHA-256 of the compiled content written into the managed block.

written.description: Whether the file was actually rewritten (false when already current).

targets.description: Every declared target with its fingerprint and whether it changed.
